notes.title: v2.0
notes.content:
added
 - Puzzle modifiers for each crewmate that should be self-explanatory when seen. These modifiers affect a certain amount of puzzle pieces randomly after a period of time.

     - Stizeha: reinforce modifier ( ignores the initial click )
     - Raeve: hidden modifier ( fades in and out )
     - Neruha: re-shuffle modifier ( randomly reshuffles that piece to another rotation)
     - Raiko: shrink modifier ( shrinks the puzzle piece, reverts after a few seconds )
     - Lune: swirl modifier ( flips the puzzle piece around to disorientate )
     - Sairu: disable modifier ( can't be interacted with for a second )

 - Beefed up the journal entries
 - added a way to navigate back to previous stars of each stage, unlocked after the final clear

fixed

 - Disabling the timer, now actually disables it. the puzzle preview caused the timer to remain active
 - puzzle preview re-shuffling infinitely when you lose or back out
 - backing out correctly updates the puzzles
 - some puzzle combinations not registering as complete( all should work )

notes.title: v1.3
notes.content:
Added

- 20+ more puzzles to lessen the monotony, mainly on the three-star puzzles
- puzzle preview to show what the puzzle looks like solved
- sped up the camera movement a little bit

notes.title: v1.1/2 changes
notes.content:
added

- journal billboard button to re-read star quotes
- every puzzle solved adds 10 seconds to the timer
- additionally, a "disable timer" toggle has been added to the settings menu to disable the timer entirely

others that weren't noted previously

- you should no longer get the same puzzle piece twice in a row unless you hit the last one on the list
- timer starts when the puzzle is lowered completely
